pending_commit.commit_message: tast: Remove the build subcommand. Actually the subcommand was not working at all because cfg.Logger is nil: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference [signal SIGSEGV: segmentation violation code=0x1 addr=0x50 pc=0x551472] Even though we can fix the bug, the build subcommand has not been loved because of its difficult interface. For example, the command to simply build the cros bundle was as long as: tast build -workspaces \ $HOME/trunk/src/platform/tast-tests:$HOME/trunk/src/platform/tast:/usr/lib/gopath \ chromiumos/tast/local/bundles/cros /tmp/ We might want to introduce a better interface in the future, but for now, let us remove the subcommand entirely for the sake of maintainability.
